original_target.title: Diffusive mean-square displacement at fixed disorder

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original fixes weak positive lambda then lets t->infinity for all sufficiently large t, uniform bounded site law on Z3 and delta0 initial state. Black–Drogin–Hernandez current v2 uses Gaussian disorder and estimates on lambda-dependent resolvent/time scales; its bounds do not extend the horizon to infinity at fixed lambda. New OpenAI family261 is a spectral absolutely-continuous interval claim, not the required two-sided mean-square growth for delta0. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
